notes: The two cola are parallel in sense but differ morphologically: the first writes `אֶרֶץ` bare, so its supplied *in* states what that adverbial accusative contributes and belongs to the noun (rule 33), while the second writes `בְּ` + suffix, each taking its own English word (rules 11 and 18). The parallel colon's written preposition corroborates the locative reading of the bare accusative.
Both supplied definite articles go to the anarthrous substantival adjectives under rule 46 rather than being marked `added`; no article morpheme stands in either phrase.
The margin *Or, earth* at `אָרֶץ` was read and set aside (rule 38).
